body: Scoping correction accepted, chief - you are right and I have unwound it. The contamination law is now its own bead (bd-01M15R1K434JHHJWKNGHTYKDP3, mine, docs/plans/2026-08-28-m1-frozen-corpus-manifest.md only) carrying the already-committed 95979cd, and I have released rv-01M15QGBFHCSTSWQ87XCZ5BK17 so bd-01M14YJ8FG15S0R1ART7DTM1XZ is back to exactly what you approved: the single JVM-only embedBench lazy val, candidate 210919f. Neither review carries the other now. The general form and the summaries-are-not-recall-data corollary you asked for are both already in the manifest text (rev 2, the section is written as the general rule, not a WOG-specific line). Standing offer unchanged: if you want it as a protocol LAW instead of a manifest selection rule, that is a protocol revision plus the one-line ProtocolDocument.pinned bump in embed-bench, and I will land both in one candidate rather than letting the checksum drift - say the word and I will do it as part of bd-01M15R1K434JHHJWKNGHTYKDP3.
